description.narrative: BeFem's work is designed to demonstrate the obstacles that under representation and misrepresentation of women and other marginalized groups in the public sphere and news media pose in terms of gender justice and other equitable social practices. Our evidence shows that, by excluding women's and minority voices in general, a door is opened to gender and identity-based violence against the most at-risk groups, but building bridges between those who manage and work in the public sphere and media and civil society groups creates opportunities to expand an understanding of the importance of gender parity in creating a just society. The grant will support the following specific priorities and activities: - Stable, full-term contracted paid staff - Advancement of women's rights in Serbia by empowering women-led organizations and feminist activists to reclaim safe spaces and open new spaces for political and cultural dialogue - Raising awareness, activating, and mobilizing the general public for sustainable public advocacy for gender equality through the promotion of media literacy and a more balanced and fair representation of women and minority groups in Serbian media - Build the media literacy and representation skills and capacities of media representatives, women, and minority groups to ensure they have stronger voices and the right tools to advocate for their rights
